# Mabel Colby

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P19](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0019)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel is a striking woman with dark eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Personality

Mabel Colby is a striking, dark-eyed individual with a heart filled with vibrant dreams and imaginations. Her rich inner life and yearning nature are comparable to those of [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- imaginative and dream-filled  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

Mabel Colby received a letter from [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), who shared humorous stories and experiences from her time teaching school in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley). In the message, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) included copies of her students' compositions, including a romantic letter from [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md) and a piece from her favorite student, [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md).

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/mabel-colby--nell-harcourt.md)

Mabel Colby and [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) are close friends and driven scholars who attend Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy) together. As examinations approach, they navigate their academic rivalry alongside their personal bond while adjusting to life at the academy.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), +2 more_
